precedence: use_v2.jobs[job_id] supplies actual update budget, warmup, validation interval, source and objective; segformer section supplies only downstream members, normalization and BCE/Dice definition
preflight_boundary: check_research_protocol checks the downstream 2223/669 pool, TRAIN-only core25 statistics and locked event members. The independent cache acceptance plus full v2 cache audit checks 11132/599/239 optical roles; neither substitutes for the other.
ssl_selection: Known available metadata, fixed 599 observations and fixed seed views. Standardized sample/band-balanced spectral, Fine and Context MAE divided by TRAIN-only frozen baseline coefficients. Equal task means, then equal sensor means. Metadata-unknown spectral targets omitted only from separate robustness diagnostics.
training_loss: Same normalized MAE; sample exposure 6 S2 + 2 Landsat, three equally weighted task views. A view with no identifiable spectral target contributes no spectral loss. Spatial views remain available. No task labels enter optical pretraining or USE checkpoint selection.
mask_streams: sample/update, augmentation, target hiding and metadata missingness are stateless and independent of model shape; spatial masks identical across metadata diagnostic modes
context_readout: Deterministic channel grouping average to32 before learned32-to32 projections. Four scales fused at quarter resolution for segmentation. This makes all old/v2 task-head capacities and initial shared tensors identical.
recovery_probe: Only Fine features or only the mean of upsampled four canonical Context scales. Both use identical learned32 projection, Conv64-32-32 decoder (other half zero) and Linear8-32-33 target-conditioned readout. Encoder remains eval/no_grad with full parameter/buffer hashes.
target_identity: Optional physical3 + known3 + visible-only per-band standardized mean/std2. Summary never reads hidden values. All-zero unknown physical input has exactly zero encoder metadata contribution.
segmentation_loss: 0.5 valid-aware BCE + 0.5 valid-aware Dice, original project functions, threshold0.5. Frozen encoder receives image-derived observation quality; label validity remains solely in the loss/evaluator.
old_reference: outputs/use_independent_frozen/pretraining/multisensor/best.pt; four context scales are deterministic valid-count-normalized pooling, not independent spatial pretraining
units: Adapters reuse calibrated physical reflectance and fixed per-sensor TRAIN-derived standardization. Simulated missing metadata does not imply arbitrary unknown DN calibration.
area30: Area average in local UTM; 64-segment densified source footprint intersects each 30m target cell to measure coverage; valid observation area >=0.8. Preserve source envelope and native-band physical metadata. Geographic-pair cross-sensor alignment is not claimed.
cost_scope: Forward MAC explicitly counts Linear/Conv/MHA products. Training profiler counts supported forward/backward matrix products; fused or non-matrix operations can be omitted. These are declared counting scopes, not an exhaustive hardware instruction total.
handoff: READY_FOR_AUDIT only. Independent C must bind READY_FOR_TRAINING to the final manifest SHA256 before B can start any of the 30 formal jobs. Formal total 92000 updates; no extra seed, second labeled task, download or longer budget.
